candidate_description: Replace only Wan DiT BF16 GEMM dispatch with cached cuBLASLt plans using frozen heuristic indices: default 2, FF2 (K=14336,N=3072) 5, and algorithm 0 when the preferred index is unavailable. Matrix layouts, BF16 inputs/outputs, FP32 compute, all solver arithmetic, sampler settings, precision, TeaCache state, CUDA kernel math outside GEMM dispatch, codec settings, public schema, and lifecycle behavior remain unchanged. Exact paired and frozen-profile MP4/RGB parity is a required promotion gate, not an assumed property.
schedule: five repetitions; seeded arm order per repetition; fresh native Wan process per arm block; one excluded warmup per shape before its measured request; fixed wide,tall,square order within arm
cold_prefix_policy: model load and every warmup are retained separately and excluded from warm medians/p95; outliers remain in all statistics
source_policy: exact frozen real public FLUX.2 wide/tall/square PNG bytes and evaluation RGB from the bound baseline profile
client_policy: identical public POST /v1/visual/render requests with teacache_thresh omitted in both arms; no manual modality or frame-budget control
latency_reporting: every measured wide/tall/square public playable/complete artifact must be below 5000 ms; report per-shape and pooled median, p95, maximum, every raw value, and every outlier without selecting shapes or pairs
cancellation_protocol: one real non-streaming click-to-animate disconnect per arm, one second after observed native submit; record native abort terminal, client/health settlement, late native records and zero public media; immediate same-source retry must match that arm's exact MP4 hash. The route exposes no request id, so /abort ACK is NOT_APPLICABLE rather than fabricated.
analysis: report all raw latencies, median/p95/max/IQR/MAD, per-shape paired deltas, all quality values, exact MP4/profile parity, cancellation timing, failures and outliers; no post-observation threshold or variant changes
promotion_rule: PROMOTED only when every NS-02 exact-media/quality, per-geometry latency, pooled speed, cancellation and recovery gate passes with no lifecycle regression. Otherwise NOT_PROMOTED and remove the candidate from the final runtime. Numeric fidelity is not perceptual judging.
historical_candidate_policy: Tasks #79/#86 approximate TeaCache candidates and their failed evidence remain unchanged and diagnostic only; this v1 exact-CUDA candidate has zero TeaCache in both arms and is not a threshold or schedule sweep.
